LESSON: READING 8.4.1 INTENSIVE READING: POETRY

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.4: Reading 8.4.1 Intensive Reading: Poetry
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 8.4.1 Intensive Reading: Poetry, part of Strand 8 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why are human characters important in poetry? 2. How can you identify the lessons learned from poems?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 8.4.1 Intensive Reading: Poetry together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: A learner contributes to group decision-making by participating actively in the

discussion on what each character does or says in each poem.

● Learning to learn: A learner builds on their own learning experiences while relating the human characters in the poem

with real life situations.

Values:
● Peace: A learner bonds as they work in groups

● Love: A learner relates human characters to real life. In the process, they grow to love each other

Link to other subjects:

● All languages: French, German, Arabic, and Chinese have poetry as a genre of literature

● Performing arts: role-playing involves performance

Suggested Learning Resources

● Digital devices with assistive technology for video recording and audio recording

● Aloud, role play, learner recordings
